rumours_heard: Day 1, Türos Tem: Cassia already knew a tale (Loremastery) that an elven wizard-lord is behind the beastman raiders, bent on revenge against the Empire.
Day 12, Türos Tem: the legate, asked for help, mentioned that elves still live in the forests of Southern Argollë but have gone feral and crave the flesh of men.
Day 32, Türos Tem: the legate said the beastman raids have grown worse and worse ever since the earthquake a few years ago.
Day 32, Türos Tem: Priestess Genelen confided that villagers and soldiers suffer nightmares; she suspects a curse.

Day 38, the buried temple: drunken brigands, friendly over a shared bottle, said the hobgoblins butchered the goblins, an ogre at the west end of the northern hall takes tribute (gold or meat), the orcs charge 20 a head, and their chief Drusus would welcome hard folk.
Day 38, the buried temple: overawed kobold guards babbled about 'the great purple one' who sleeps in the stepped tower in the courtyard, and whom they serve in terror.
Day 48, the buried temple: friendly orcs, boasting, said 'the Lady Below' rewards any band that wipes out one of her lesser tribes, as she rewarded the Red Eye gnolls.

Day 171, the Imperial road (21.09), a friendly merchant camped by the road: the Argollëan Family has stepped up its shadow war on Sand & Bones in Cyfaraun, murdering merchants who would use Selene's services instead; hence the mutilated corpses on the river banks.
Day 176, Cyfaraun, drinkers in a tavern: adventurers who want to prove themselves as gladiators before the next festival should try the Silk Pony: good coin if you don't mind blood.
Day 177, Cyfaraun, drinkers in a tavern: the Order of the Eclipse beheads the bodies in the river; beware those who serve the Lady of Fortune, a dark goddess of buried riches.

Day 178, Cyfaraun, a patron of the Mink, asked about the sewers: poor Tavus Ionicus, last of a ruined landless patrician house, went mad and lost what little he had; maybe he lives with the lepers in the undercity.

Day 195, the Undercity cesspool, six filthy, twitchy wall-tappers (friendly): the regent of the wizards' chapterhouse wants to meet adventurers heading past the border forts into the Waste, and pays for credible news of threats from there.

Day 230, Cyfaraun, Lucilla's old contacts (Rumormongering), asked how treasure hunters keep clear of the tax men: Liber Faunus is no ordinary merchant but one of the most dangerous men in the city: costly to work with, true to his word if you keep yours, cheaper than the tax man. Never smuggle into the Old District without his blessing.
Day 230, Cyfaraun, Lucilla's old contacts: Selene Nictorian of the Silk Pony has a heart of steel: debtors who don't pay her vanish and are never found.
Day 230, Cyfaraun, Lucilla's old contacts: river pirates preying on bargemen are behind all the bodies in the river; their base is upstream near the mountains.

Day 230, Cyfaraun, Lucilla's old contacts: Lanista Celictor Nuvicus bought a monstrous crocodile and other beasts for the next seasonal festival, though he denies it; maybe a surprise to upstage Maximus.

Day 257, Cyfaraun, Lucilla's old contacts (Rumormongering, month 9): beheaded bodies of lepers and vagrants were found floating in the river by the south wall the morning after the last new moon; the Watch is not looking, since nobody cares for outcasts.
Day 257, Cyfaraun, Lucilla's old contacts: a few young wizards have taken a great interest in the city's rats: exterminators, or a mad rat cult?

Day 271, Cyfaraun, Lucilla's old contacts (Rumormongering, month 10): the city wants new gladiators against Maximus's beastmen; beating one of his ogres alone on the sands wins the city's love, and the few who did are now rich and free.
Day 271, Cyfaraun, Lucilla's old contacts: nobody has seen them in years, but the Brotherhood of Knives is still in business as killers for hire.
Day 271, Cyfaraun, Lucilla's old contacts: Prefect Basilio has gone mad and hired assassins to kill merchants he suspects of smuggling; the bodies are dumped in the river as a warning.

Day 273, Cyfaraun, a friendly traveller in the Temple District (took the party for the Imperial Vanguard): bargemen unloading a secret night cargo at the north-west river pier were killed by something; a drunk chirurgeon swears the bite marks are a dragon's. The cargo is gone.

Day 301, Cyfaraun, Lucilla's old contacts (Rumormongering, month 11): Nicean wine merchant Vasan Tikala refuses to sell his best wine at the Emporium; he sells only at night by the river to dodge thieves and tax men, but with the bodies turning up no one will meet him.

Day 301, Cyfaraun, Lucilla's old contacts: everyone loves Maximus, the Strong Silver Sword, for fielding beastmen; everyone except the rival lanistae Celictor Nuvicus and Omnus Pluris. His beastmen made the festivals more exciting and lucrative.
